title: DR1 labels a hub task either "To do" or "Complete"; the frontend calls the same two states "Not yet started" and "Completed" and adds a third, "In progress".

finding.frontend: The hub tags an untouched task "Not yet started" in blue, a finished one "Completed" in green and a part-finished one "In progress" in light blue; the captured hub shows all three at once against the first three rows. The wording is set in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/copy/copy.en.js:11-17 and mapped to the internal statuses in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js:51-63.
finding.prototype: DR1 has two statuses and no more: "To do" in blue and "Complete" in green, chosen per row by a single completeness test (app/routes.js:5736-5737). A task that has been started but not finished still reads "To do".
finding.difference: Rename the tags to "To do" and "Complete", and decide what to do with the in-progress state DR1 does not define — either fold it into "To do" to match DR1, or keep it and record that the frontend deliberately says more than DR1 does. The "Optional" and "Cannot start yet" statuses the frontend also renders are separate findings.
finding.falsifiedBy: A frontend hub whose unfinished rows read "To do" and whose finished rows read "Complete".
finding.verification: Opened the fe-hub and dr1-notification-hub DOMs and both screenshots and read hub/copy/copy.en.js:11-17, hub/controller.js:51-68 and routes.js:5736-5737. Ran the falsifier by extracting every status element from each DOM: fe-hub carries `govuk-tag--green Completed`, `govuk-tag--light-blue In progress` and `govuk-tag--blue Not yet started` against its first three rows exactly as claimed, plus the untagged "Optional" and "Cannot start yet" the finding correctly hands to other findings; the DR1 hub carries `govuk-tag--blue To do` on all ten of its rows and nothing else. Verified the vocabulary against source as well as markup, since a two-status claim on a capture where nothing is complete could be an artefact of the capture: routes.js declares exactly `statusComplete` and `statusTodo` and every one of the twelve possible items picks between those two, so DR1 has no third state to show. Both cited ranges resolve to what the sentences say. RUBRIC 9 fired on one phrase only, corrected below; the user-facing claim does not move. CORRECT.
finding.correction: CLAIMED (frontend slot): the status copy is "mapped to the five internal states in hub/controller.js:51-63". TRUE: STATUS_TAG holds four entries — fulfilled, optional, in-progress and not-started — plus a not-started fallback. The fifth internal state, not-applicable, never reaches a tag: a not-applicable conditional row is dropped from the list at controller.js:93 and :116-118 instead. CHECKED against controller.js:51-68 and bridge/status/index.js:87-91. Slot reworded to "the internal statuses"; the three-statuses-against-two claim the finding rests on is unaffected.

relatedTo.why: the Optional tag is the fourth status the frontend renders and DR1 does not
